name: Thunder Subtitle
description: Scheduled task that finds movies in the selected libraries that have no subtitles at all, extracts the release code from the file name (ABF-363-U.strm -> ABF-363), queries the Xunlei subtitle API, downloads every candidate, drops machine-translated ones, picks the best remaining candidate by dialogue volume and writes it next to the .strm as <name>.chi.srt/.ass so Jellyfin picks it up as an external subtitle. A second task re-picks better subtitles for files this plugin wrote earlier.
overview: 为按番号命名的影片从迅雷字幕 API 自动下载高质量外挂字幕。
